module: Manages the list of drag race lanes in the editor: loading from gameplay_drag_saveSystem, selection, adding, removing, saving to a <id>.lane.json file in the level's drag folder, and drawing the ImGui UI (list and details: ID, names, color, order, boundaryId).
notes: Selection indices are 1-based; -1 means no selection.
Proposed colors: blue, red, green, yellow, purple, orange.
Lane waypoints come from the strip prefab; the Waypoints section only displays a help text.
drawAxisBox draws some triangles twice with different permutations; drawTransformsPreview writes the lane name at (0,0,0).

getAllLanes.desc: Returns the list of loaded lanes.

getSelectedLaneIndex.desc: Index (1-based) of the selected lane, -1 if none.

setSelectedLaneIndex.desc: Sets the selected index without logging.

returns.desc: lane or nil if the index is out of bounds

selectLane.desc: Selects the lane at the given index and logs its name.

addLane.desc: Adds a "New Lane" lane (color blue, next laneOrder, empty waypointIds, metadata created/modified), selects it and marks unsaved changes.

removeSelectedLane.desc: Removes the selected lane and moves the selection to the previous one; -1 if the list becomes empty.

saveLane.desc: Saves the lane to <level drag folder>/<lane.id>.lane.json via dragSaveSystem.saveLane.

returns.desc: false if there is no lane or no level loaded, otherwise the result of dragSaveSystem.saveLane

drawLanesSection.desc: Draws the ImGui panel of the lane list (Add Lane, Remove, Save buttons, selectable list with tooltip).

drawLaneDetails.desc: Draws the ImGui panel of the selected lane's details (Basics, Waypoints, Boundary); fields modify the lane and mark unsaved changes.

drawTransformsPreview.desc: Displays the text "Lane: <name>" at the origin as 3D debug for the selected lane.

drawAxisBox.desc: Draws a solid box as debug (colored triangles and black edges) from a corner and three axis vectors.
